7f542350-af8f-11f0-8dee-07b8798c5737.t: Distinct from 'TX|Pacifico Energy GW Ranch' (Longfellow Ranch, 568 acres, ~60 km SE of Aterio's GW Ranch on TX-18; Aterio maps GW Ranch to 29cae850). But public evidence contradicts Aterio's Construction/High for buildings 1-2: the anchor tenant and funding collapsed (Apr-2026), Poolside pulled its announcement post (Aterio 07-14), and Aterio itself sees no work after initial clearing. 8 in-window buildings (1,000 MW facility, 2029-03..2030-12) not rowed.
